summary_1line: A guest advises the questioning Brahmana to seek the wise Naga Padmanabha at Naimisha forest, who can explain the highest form of religion.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the forest of Naimisha by the Gomati, assembled gods perform a grand sacrifice beneath tall sacrificial posts and rising smoke.
The radiant Naga sage Padmanabha sits in serene dignity in his city, surrounded by attendants while teaching righteousness.
